reply.analysis: Proven: beta = 364 for the 1365-receiver graph. The lower bound 364 is an independent set; the upper bound 364 is a linear code M = I + 6A over F_7 (one code tried, meets_lower true). All four checks passed: independent_set, code_fits, factorization, decoding. Baselines: CP-SAT alpha reached 364 but was not proven within 120 s; CP-SAT cover returned nothing; fractional cover gave 1341, unproven; F2 minrank SAT only reached 363 as a lower bound in 1.03 s. The earlier Kushagra agent also closed 364 to 364 with field 7 in 0.80 s, faster than this agent's 50.852 s wall time, of which 50.327 s was LLM time (compute 0.525 s). Nothing suspicious; the agent was slower than that baseline.
